items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: But Ivie Anderson, we got her in Chicago.

ctx.x: What did you think of the singers

Well, the only one I can remember was in the show "Jump for Joy", I don't know who hired her, Dorothy Dandridge. Duke didn't have nothing to do with that. But Ivie Anderson, we got her in Chicago. Oh yeah, whatever she did, she was suffering with asthma, you know? And she could hardly -- sometimes they used to tell me that down South, she had it so bad, she would have to go out on the street to get some air because she's couldn't hardly breathe, but she could be feeling bad right now on the stage and go there and…
